description: An oil painting of a bespectacled man in waistcoat and rolled sleeves writing capital letters on paper at a wooden desk in a dim studio. Beside him is a sign-board with a red roundel and a band reading UNDERGROUND, with a second line reading UNDERGROUN. Ink pots, brushes, rolled papers and books surround him. No frame or border; the painting fills the image.
reason: Legible lettering is painted in: the sign reads UNDERGROUND and a misspelled UNDERGROUN, and the sheets show ABCDEF GHIJK KL. Regenerate with no readable letters on the sign or paper.
